title: Selector decoding
statement: Let $S$ be a finite type with decidable equality, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a Boolean vector indexed by the $|\mathrm{TabSel}(S,k)|$ positions. If $b$ is the encoding of some selector, decode it as such a selector; otherwise return the selector of the form $\mathrm{sym}(\mathrm{none},\mathrm{false},\mathrm{false})$.
hypotheses_covered: $b$ is a Boolean vector indexed by the selector positions
